thread:
Aisha: quick sync — after last week's postmortem I'm opening this thread to track the follow-ups for streaming/chat partial responses and reconnect storms. noticed recurring pattern across two model versions.
Tom: +1. can you drop the short incident log and repro?
Aisha: pasted minimal excerpt below — pattern: normal stream -> exact same session id reconnects -> partial chunk markers -> client retries flood.
Aisha: ```
2026-03-19T09:11:02Z stream session s=xyz conn=0x1a2 recv chunk-len=512
2026-03-19T09:11:16Z stream session s=xyz recv chunk-len=0 partial=true
2026-03-19T09:11:17Z proxy resp 504 upstream read timeout after 90s
2026-03-19T09:11:17Z client sdk reconnect attempt=1 backoff=1s
2026-03-19T09:11:18Z client sdk reconnect attempt=2 backoff=1s
```
Priya: looks like client backoff isn't jittered — that explains the reconnect storm. also saw a GC sweep on model-host-7 at 09:10 which aligns.
Omar: suggest 3 parallel tracks: proxy-side debounce + server-side session pinning, client SDK backoff fix with jitter & max-backoff, and metric/alerting to catch partial-token regressions.
Tom: volunteer for proxy debounce PR. my plan: add short-circuit that blackholes SYNs from the same session-id for 8s after a validated partial chunk event. I'll open a draft PR and link for review. ETA Tue 03/23.
Priya: I'll file the SDK issue and propose a patch adding exponential backoff with full jitter and an upper bound of 60s, plus an opt-in exponential+retry-count telemetry field. assigning to @priya. ETA Mon 03/22.
Aisha: I'll own the observability piece: create a "partial_token_rate" metric (per-model-version, per-region) and a composite alert that fires when partial_token_rate > 0.5% and reconnect_rate increases by >10% in 5m. Dashboard by Wed 03/24.
Omar: infra will bump model-host GC threshold and add a tiny pre-warm pool (2 warm instances) for the top 3 busiest models. This reduces cold-GC pressure. target next sprint.
InfraBot: Created follow-up ticket TKT-5598 and linked INC-4399. https://tracker/redwood/TKT-5598
Tom: also adding a lightweight golden test to CI: open a 10m stream, assert no partial chunks and sustained token throughput. will add to nightly runs.
Priya: once SDK change lands, will coordinate a client-side opt-in rollout to avoid mass upgrade at once. will post rollout plan in #devex.
Aisha: action items summary in one line: Tom -> proxy debounce PR (due 03/23), Priya -> SDK jitter/backoff PR + rollout plan (due 03/22), Aisha -> metric + alert + dashboard (due 03/24), Omar -> GC/pre-warm (sprint). adding owners to the incident ticket.
Tom: adding a short mitigation to runbook: if partial spikes, enable proxy soft-debounce via feature-flag and force-prewarm for affected model. documented rollback steps.
Priya: also adding client-side heuristics to detect mid-stream partials and surface a labelled telemetry event so SRE can correlate.
Omar: ops support for first two weeks of monitoring rotation. Omar and Priya will do week 1, SRE (Tom) week 2, then ProdEng (Aisha) weekly review.
Aisha: please tag me on PRs. I'll keep INC-4399 updated with dashboards and correlation links. planning a short summary for the weekly all-hands.
InfraBot: Synthetic runner scheduled: streaming-golden-check runs nightly at 02:00 UTC. Notification set to #eng-oncall on failures.
Tom: noted. thanks team — let's try to keep follow-ups tight and close by end of sprint.
Aisha: closing thread; ongoing updates will be in TKT-5598/INC-4399 and the dashboard. ping if you want to swap owners.
